Project Overview

A Destination Shaped by Nature and Comfort

The Cavo is a Camp & Lounge concept envisioned as a coastal destination in Egypt, offering an experience built around relaxation, adventure, and connection with nature.

The project involved developing a complete visual identity from the ground up, translating the concept into a distinctive brand language that reflects the atmosphere and experience the destination aims to offer. The identity was designed to balance the freedom of outdoor living with the comfort and exclusivity of a refined lounge experience.

Location Egypt

02 / 10

The Challenge

The main challenge was to create a recognizable identity for a new hospitality concept without relying on an established brand presence. The visual direction needed to communicate the freedom and spirit of outdoor adventure, the calm and simplicity of nature, the comfort of a carefully designed leisure experience, and a sense of exclusivity without losing authenticity.

Creative Requirements

Nature, freedom, relaxation, exclusivity, and authenticity.

Key Objectives

Unify the outdoor and lounge experience in one coherent visual language.

Visual Objective

Create a distinctive and versatile identity for digital and physical touchpoints.

04 / 10

Creative Concept

Nature, Adventure, and Comfort in One Symbol

THE CORE IDEA
The creative concept draws inspiration from the natural elements of a coastal camping environment. The central visual idea combines a flame with symbolic landscape elements, including mountains, a tent, palm trees, and water. The concept brings together the warmth of a campfire, the openness of nature, and the spirit of exploration in a single distinctive symbol. Rather than representing camping through a conventional illustration, the mark creates a compact visual expression of the experience behind The Cavo.

The result is a distinctive symbol that brings the brand experience together in one cohesive visual expression.

Visual Identity System

A Visual Language Inspired by the Coast

Color Palette

The visual identity translates the brand's natural and relaxed character into a cohesive design language. Sand Beige draws from coastal landscapes, Sunset Orange reflects sunlight and campfire warmth, and Ocean Teal evokes the calmness and depth of the sea.

Sand Beige#D79A5C
Sunset Orange#C56A34
Ocean Teal#2D6661
Olive Green#6FA56A
Warm Brown#8B5E3C
Soft Ivory#F2E9DA
Muted Gold#D4AF37
Ocean Light#63C6E3

Typography & Graphic Elements

Cinzel Decorative introduces a distinctive display character, Poppins supports the identity with a clean contemporary structure, and Cairo provides Arabic language support. Natural-inspired elements and patterns extend the identity beyond the logo and reinforce its outdoor atmosphere.

09 / 10

Social Media Identity

Exploring the Brand in Digital Communication

DIGITAL COMMUNICATION

Content Direction

A collection of experimental social media designs was developed to explore how The Cavo visual language could extend into digital communication. The nine-post presentation demonstrates possible content directions, combining brand elements, visual storytelling, and promotional-style layouts. These designs are conceptual explorations rather than published campaign materials.

10 / 10

Brand Experience

Where Nature Meets Comfort

The final identity brings together the visual and conceptual elements of The Cavo into one coherent brand direction. From the logo and color palette to typography, graphic patterns, and application concepts, every element contributes to expressing a destination shaped by nature, freedom, and relaxation.

The proposed identity was presented to the client and approved with modifications. The applications and social media visuals in this case study are conceptual mockups created to demonstrate the identity system, not confirmed physical production or published campaigns.
